description: Free calculator for UK take-home pay: converts weekly, fortnightly or 4-weekly pay to an average month, splits it 50/30/20, sets aside yearly bills monthly, says how much of pay goes on essentials, and suggests the matching Tidy Quid planner plus the free Budget Starter. Arithmetic only, not advice. Stores nothing.

annual_bills.description: Total of once-a-year bills (MOT, car tax, insurance, TV Licence, Christmas) in GBP

goal.description: Optional, e.g. 'Christmas', 'save for a wedding', 'energy bills'

monthly_bills.description: Monthly essentials: rent/mortgage, council tax, energy, food, transport, debts (GBP)

take_home_pay.description: Pay after tax, NI and pension, in GBP, per pay period

name: check_uk_budget
title: UK budget check (50/30/20)
